meta_description: Tranah Garden Services provides expert gardening in Southampton and Hedge End. Lawn care, planting, maintenance and design. Call us today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Professional garden design, maintenance, and landscaping across Southampton. We transform tired gardens into outdoor spaces you'll actually use.
services_heading: Complete Garden Services Across Southampton & Hedge End
services_subhead: From seasonal maintenance to full garden redesigns, we handle every aspect of garden care with attention to detail and real expertise.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Upkeep
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidying. We work on monthly, quarterly, or one-off basis to keep your garden looking its best year-round.

services.title: Landscape Design & Installation
services.desc: Custom garden designs tailored to your space and vision. We handle soil prep, planting schemes, patio laying, and garden structures to create outdoor rooms you'll love.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Overseeding, aeration, feeding, and weed control to restore tired grass. We'll diagnose problems like moss and bare patches and bring your lawn back to life.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping to promote healthy growth and improve sight lines. We remove dead wood, manage overgrowth, and maintain structure safely.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Rubbish Removal
services.desc: Full clearance of overgrown gardens, waste removal, and site preparation. Perfect for new-build properties or inherited gardens that need a fresh start.

services.title: Planting & Garden Borders
services.desc: Seasonal bedding, herbaceous borders, and permanent planting schemes. We select plants suited to your soil, light, and maintenance preferences.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own home. That's the difference.
about_para_1: Tranah Garden Services was founded over 20 years ago by someone who got tired of watching beautiful gardens fall into neglect. What started as a one-man operation now serves hundreds of homeowners across Southampton and Hedge End. We've built our reputation on reliability, honest pricing, and genuinely caring about the end result.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we listen, we turn up when we say we will, and we deliver work that lasts. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair — and you'll spend less on replacements if the job's done right the first time. Many clients have been with us for over a decade.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. The garden was a complete mess when we bought the house — overgrown, weeds everywhere. James and the team cleared it all, laid a new patio, and planted it out beautifully. They even came back the following spring to make sure everything had settled in. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Tranah for about five years now. They come every month, keep the lawn pristine, and are never any bother. Friendly lads, reliable as they come. Why would you use anyone else?
reviews.author: Patricia M.

reviews.text: Called them in an emergency when our neighbour's tree was damaging the fence. Within two weeks they'd assessed it, got the work scheduled, and did a brilliant job. Fair pricing too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David R.
